fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, NewsArticle ld+json which carries full articleBody inline) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, Google News sitemap) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_paywalled.title: Paywalled
_paywalled.description: True when isAccessibleForFree is explicitly false.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek, from the NewsArticle ld+json block.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, carried inline in the NewsArticle ld+json block (no HTML fallback needed on this site).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name(s), normalized to a list of names extracted from the ld+json author Person array.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher name, extracted from the ld+json NewsMediaOrganization publisher object.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords as emitted upstream in ld+json.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item (news:title).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL (loc) from the Google News sitemap.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: Publication date (news:publication_date) from the Google News sitemap.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
